company.name: Eisen
company.shortDescription: Eisen is a compliance operations platform that helps financial institutions manage escheatment, disbursement, and 1099 reporting.
company.description: Eisen is a compliance operations platform that helps financial institutions manage escheatment, disbursement, and regulatory reporting processes for dormant or inactive accounts. The company provides tools that automate workflows related to unclaimed property compliance, including customer outreach, stale check management, failed payouts, and account offboarding. Its platform integrates with existing financial systems to help organizations monitor dormancy risk, track state reporting deadlines, and manage fund disbursements across different account types. Eisen also offers solutions tailored for industries such as banking, credit unions, insurance, telecommunications, retirement plan administration, and cryptocurrency platforms. In addition to software tools, the company supports operational compliance activities by helping businesses manage regulatory obligations tied to inactive assets and unclaimed property laws.
